author: 网络
quote_zh: 有人说：随便找一句话，在前面加上“有人说”，在句尾加上“也有人认为不尽如此，你怎么看？”便可以成为上海卷的作文题目，也有人认为不尽如此，你怎么看？
quote_en: Some people say: find a random sentence, add "someone said" before the sentence, add "some people think so, what do you think?" It can become the title of the composition of Shanghai Volume. Some people think that it is not so, what do you think?
